sources.title: 10 Best LLM Tools To Run Models Locally (August 2026) - Unite.AI
sources.snippet: Developers, privacy-conscious teams, hobbyists, and small businesses can now download capable open models, run them on a laptop or workstation, connect them to documents, expose local APIs, and build private AI workflows without sending every prompt to a hosted model provider. The best local LLM tools solve different parts of that workflow.
